about: The mod shop's curated list. The pages workflow takes each file from its author's GitHub release (repo, tag, file), or from their repository at a commit (repo, commit, path), checks it against the sha256 here, and puts it on the site; nothing here is committed but this list. Only mods whose licence allows passing them on. kind 'core': a core the listed mods need, added to the site's cores. needs_core: the oldest core version the mod links with. on_unit: what has been checked on real hardware, shown in the details sheet. license: only for a file that names none (then the repository's licence). thumb: the card's picture of the screen (128x64, two colours: packaging/thumbs.py), pinned on its own like a file (tag and file, or commit and path, and sha256); it goes in or changes only through a reviewed pull request, and deleting it takes it off the site. hold: the shop keeps this file until a maintainer changes it; the daily update check (packaging/shop_updates.py) leaves it, and an update through the form waits for a review.

items.summary: Lets machine mods built for it share one build: it draws each machine's SRC and LFO pages from what the machine describes, and from 1.2 gives a machine seven more SRC values per sound and lets a page knob be a stock sound parameter. Needs core 3.0 or newer, which the shop takes for it; on its own it changes nothing. DT-FM 1.2.1, DIGISLICER 2.5 and digi1_mods' machines (Digi Mono, Digi Poly, Digi Macro, DH-101) are built for it. Not with the shop's machine mods that draw their own pages: NEIGHBOR 0.6 and SOPHIE.
items.on_unit: 1.2 ran on a Digitakt mk1, tested by the author with no problems, as did 1.0 (on OS 1.54 with core 3.0 and six machine mods built for it). 1.2 is also checked in digikit's emulator on OS 1.53 and 1.54 with core 4.0: every screen and the audio the same as stock.
items.hold: Other machine mods build on it: a maintainer checks each new version first.

Machines for the Digitone: sounds that play a machine mod's voice in place of FM, through the Digitone's own filter, mixer and effects, with the AMP page's envelope. MACHINES in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) picks the held track's machine, and a machine track's SYN1 and SYN2 knobs become the machine's. On its own it adds the menu and nothing else: a machine mod built for it ticks it here. Needs core-dn1 3.1, which the shop takes for it.

What the Digitone's effect mods share (DigiSwarm, DigiPrism, DigiTide, DigiTriad, DigiReel, DigiHoard, DigiHalo from 0.2): one effect at a time owns the audio, with a mixer around it (input levels as loud as the Digitone's own input), two LFOs on the stock LFO page, p-locks kept in the pattern and the MIDI hand-off. On its own it adds nothing: an effect that needs it ticks it here. Needs core-dn1 4.1, which the shop takes for it.
items.on_unit: Tested on a Digitone mk1 by its author with the 0.2 effects (Oct 2026); still a beta. Also checked in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. Not yet run on a Digitone Keys.

items.summary: An effects engine for the audio inputs: eleven engines with four variations, a 60-second looper, Hold, Reverse and MIDI CCs, on a page like the Digitone's own. With fxkit (0.2): a mixer, two LFOs on the stock LFO page aimed at its controls, p-locks kept in the pattern, and the MIDI tracks editable while it plays. The synths are silent while it is the active effect.

items.on_unit: DA27 was installed and tested on a physical Digitone MK1 by its owner. MIDI arpeggiation, native panel controls, graphical step editor, track settings and additional modes are largely functional. One held key with transport stopped can intermittently produce unintended extra pitches; see the release known limitations. Emulator and SDK checks are recorded in TEST_RESULTS.md. Further hardware validation is welcome.

items.summary: A four-operator FM synth machine: eight algorithms, drawn on ALGO's knob, with each operator's ratio, level and envelope, and feedback on operator 4. items.summary: An Oberheim OB-1 oscillator section as an SRC machine: two VCOs, each with saw type (triangle to saw) and pulse type (narrow pulse to square) and a sub-octave, hard sync and cross mod, noise, and the OB-1's mixer (ON, -3 dB or OFF). items.summary: Diagnostics for the Analog Rytm MKII: CPU, DSP, RAM and free sample memory in the top bar (SYSTEM INFO), and a USB channel that reads them and presses the panel's keys, encoders and pads from a computer (REMOTE KEYS). After irpina's digihealth.
items.on_unit: Yes, on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74. This exact file (1.3) has run in the unit test builds since 26 Oct 2026, with core-ar2 0.8 to 0.11: the readout and the USB stats answered, and its remote keys drove the tests. Version 1.2 also ran with the released core-ar2 0.3.

items.summary: Eleven Analog Rytm MKII mods by MrScruff, ported to elemod: FILTER Hz readout, CTRL ALL, ENV RESET AMP, SLICE LOOP, euclid accents, velocity humanise, LFO RND, compressor preview, main-out light, kit A/B, DAC sum and voice filter. OS 1.74.
items.on_unit: Yes, on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74. These exact eleven files (release v1.4) were verified byte for byte against the build that ran on the unit on 23 Oct 2026 with core-ar2 0.6, where every mod passed its own check (voice-dac 1.4's DAC FILTER page by TYP among them). The same mods ran earlier on core-ar2 0.3, 0.4 and 0.5. Not yet flashed with core-ar2 0.7 itself, the core the shop lists. Ports of MrScruff's rytm-mods-src; they match his build label by label.
